C0770.title: Shanghai Police Solve 607 Cyber Cases This Year: Hackers Shift from Showing Off to Profit-Seeking; Police Officer Information Leak or...
C0770.summary: In February 2017, Shanghai police investigated the city first case involving intrusion into an IoT company. The owner of an electrical equipment company instructed employees to use hacking methods to maliciously intrude into the victim company smart meter system, causing more than 900 smart meters to be forcibly shut down. Police noted that hacking into enterprise systems to illegally obtain information had become one source of citizen personal information leakage, and weak enterprise IoT protection can amplify business interruption and data leakage risks.
